rfp_requirements.title: Conduct HDDV diesel component inspections
rfp_requirements.description: All heavy-duty diesel vehicles (HDDV) over 17,999 lbs. must receive a visible smoke test, opacity test, and after-treatment indicator light checks, which may be conducted by any PIF or Private Fleet Facility (PFF).

rfp_requirements.title: Support SIFs with workstations and equipment maintenance
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must supply all workstations and maintain the equipment for the four (4) State-operated Specialty Inspection Facilities (SIFs).

rfp_requirements.title: Perform emission test components for LDGV, LDGT, HDGV, LDDV
rfp_requirements.description: Emission tests for gasoline and diesel vehicles (LDGV, LDGT, HDGV, LDDV) must include a visible smoke test, an OBD test, an emission control apparatus compliance examination (visual catalytic converter check), a visual fuel cap test, and a visual fuel leak test.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform emission test components for MDDV
rfp_requirements.description: Emission tests for Medium Duty Diesel Vehicles (MDDV) must include a visible smoke test; an opacity test with certified smoke meter (if not OBD-eligible); after-treatment and MIL light checks if applicable; an OBD test if applicable; a visual fuel leak test; and an emission control apparatus examina

rfp_requirements.title: Perform emission test components for HDDV
rfp_requirements.description: Emission tests for Heavy Duty Diesel Vehicles (HDDV) must include a visible smoke test; an opacity test with certified smoke meter (if not OBD-eligible); after-treatment and MIL light checks if applicable; an OBD test if applicable; a visual fuel leak test; and an emission control apparatus examinat

rfp_requirements.title: Describe Change Control Process
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the change control process as it relates to patches, hot-fixes, upgrades, and configuration changes within the organization, including review of proposed changes and timelines used for testing, implementation, and emergency change control.

rfp_requirements.title: Review N.J.A.C. 7:27-14 Control and Prohibition of Air Pollution from Diesel-Powered Motor Vehicles
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must review N.J.A.C. 7:27-14 to prepare an accurate and comprehensive Quote.

rfp_requirements.title: Employ Independent Third-Party Vulnerability Testing
rfp_requirements.description: Employ qualified third-parties to conduct independent vulnerability scanning, penetration testing, and red-team exercises.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe vulnerability scanning and penetration testing process
rfp_requirements.description: Describe the network vulnerability scanning and penetration testing process, who conducts them, whether scans/tests are external and internal, and how often they are conducted.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide most recent third-party application code review or penetration testing reports
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, provide details on the most recent Application Code Review or Penetration Testing Reports carried out by independent third parties.

rfp_requirements.title: Develop, implement, test, and maintain contingency plans
rfp_requirements.description: The organization develops, implements, tests, and maintains contingency plans to ensure continuity of operations for all information systems that deliver or support essential or critical business functions on behalf of the organization.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe data and system backup/recovery processes including RPO/RTO
rfp_requirements.description: Describe data and system backup/recovery processes employed and how the security categorization of information is maintained in backup media; how often backups are tested to verify media reliability and information integrity; and the recovery point and recovery time objectives.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe alternate site failover processes
rfp_requirements.description: As applicable, if an alternate site has been established, describe the processes and timelines for failing over, whether the site is Hot/Warm/Cold, how often fail-over processes are tested, and how results are documented and reviewed.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with applicable building and safety codes
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must comply with the New Jersey Uniform Construction Code, latest National Electrical Code 70, B.O.C.A. Basic Building Code, OSHA, and all applicable codes.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Bid Security
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must provide Bid Security as required.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Diane B. Allen Equal Pay Act report
rfp_requirements.description: A contractor performing qualifying services or public work shall provide the Commissioner of Labor and Workforce Development a report regarding compensation and hours worked by employees categorized by gender, race, ethnicity, and job category.

rfp_requirements.title: Remove Bidder additional terms that conflict with SSTC
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must identify and remove proposed terms and conditions that conflict with the SSTC prior to Quote submission; conflicts render a Quote non-responsive.

rfp_requirements.title: Properly classify employees (ABC Test)
rfp_requirements.description: Employer must properly classify workers as employees unless it can demonstrate all three factors of the ABC Test (freedom from control, service outside usual course of business or outside employer's places of business, and independently established trade).

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with Quote Content Requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Quote must comply with Quote Content requirements in Section 3.12.

rfp_requirements.title: Organize Quote attachments in specified order
rfp_requirements.description: Quote should be submitted with attachments organized as: Forms, Technical Quote, State-Supplied Price Sheet.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Forms, Registrations and Certifications with Quote
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must submit all required forms, registrations, and certifications with the quote.

rfp_requirements.title: Forms may be completed via NJSTART Terms and Categories Tab or attached to Vendor Profile
rfp_requirements.description: As an alternative to uploading certain forms with the Quote, a Bidder may complete several certifications electronically in NJSTART on the 'Terms and Categories' Tab within the Vendor Profile, or attach completed forms to the Vendor Profile. Refer to QRGs 'Vendor Forms' and 'Attaching Files'.

rfp_requirements.title: Conform to UK Fair Employment (Northern Ireland) Act of 1989 and permit independent monitoring
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder's MacBride certification must include conformance with the United Kingdom's Fair Employment (Northern Ireland) Act of 1989 and permit independent monitoring of compliance with the MacBride principles as set forth in N.J.S.A. 52:18A-89.5.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not designate Price Sheet, Catalog, or entire Quote as confidential
rfp_requirements.description: The Bidder must not designate its State-Supplied Price Sheet, Price List/Catalog, and/or the entire Quote as proprietary and/or confidential, or claim copyright protection for its entire Quote.

rfp_requirements.title: Automatic certification of self-performance if no Subcontractors listed
rfp_requirements.description: For a Quote that does NOT include the use of any Subcontractors, the Bidder is automatically certifying that, if selected for award, the Bidder will be performing all work required by the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: No subcontractor work without Director's written approval
rfp_requirements.description: No substituted or additional Subcontractors are authorized to begin work until the Contractor has received written approval from the Director.

rfp_requirements.title: Contract is Small Business Subcontracting Set-Aside
rfp_requirements.description: This is a Contract with set-aside subcontracting for New Jersey Small Business Enterprises. Bidders intending to subcontract must submit a Subcontractor Utilization Plan and take good faith efforts to solicit and hire eligible NJ Small Business Enterprises.

rfp_requirements.title: Cooperate with State compliance studies/surveys
rfp_requirements.description: Each Bidder awarded a Contract with the set-aside subcontracting requirement shall fully cooperate in any studies or surveys conducted by the State to determine compliance with N.J.A.C. 17:13-1.1 et seq. and this Bid Solicitation.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Technical Quote
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must submit a Technical Quote as part of its response.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe approach and plans for Scope of Work in Technical Quote
rfp_requirements.description: The Bidder shall describe its approach and plans for accomplishing the work outlined in the Scope of Work and set forth its understanding of the requirements and approach to successfully complete the Contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Management Overview
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must provide a Management Overview as part of the Quote.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Management Overview narrative
rfp_requirements.description: The Bidder shall set forth its overall technical approach and plans to meet the requirements of the Bid Solicitation in a narrative format, demonstrating understanding of objectives, nature of work, and level of effort required.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Contract Management Plan
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must provide Contract Management information as part of the Quote.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe Contract Management plan
rfp_requirements.description: The Bidder should describe its specific plans to manage, control and supervise the Contract to ensure satisfactory Contract completion, including approach to communicate with the State Contract Manager (status meetings, status reports, etc.).

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Contract Schedule
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must provide a Contract Schedule as part of the Quote.

rfp_requirements.title: Include draft Contract schedule
rfp_requirements.description: The Bidder shall include a draft Contract schedule that incorporates key dates, identifies the completion date for each task/subtask, associated deliverables, and the scheduling/control methodology and rationale.

rfp_requirements.title: Register under Public Works Contractor Registration Act
rfp_requirements.description: All Contractors, subcontractors, and lower-tier subcontractors engaging in any contract for public work must be first registered with the New Jersey Department of Labor and Workforce Development pursuant to N.J.S.A. 34:11-56.51.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Acceptable Use Policy (AUP)
rfp_requirements.description: Bidder must indicate whether all personnel are required to sign an Acceptable Use Policy; if yes, submit a copy of the AUP; if no, explain.

rfp_requirements.title: Submit Quote withdrawal requests in writing with required identifiers
rfp_requirements.description: Post-opening Quote withdrawal requests must include the Bid Solicitation Number, Bid Solicitation Title, and the Quote submission date, and be sent to Procurement.Bureau@treas.nj.gov.

rfp_requirements.title: Demonstrate good faith to withdraw Quote after opening
rfp_requirements.description: After Quote opening but before Contract award, withdrawal requests must demonstrate good faith via factors including: mistake so significant that enforcement would be unconscionable; mistake relates to a material feature/term of the Contract; and mistake occurred notwithstanding Bidder's exercise of

rfp_requirements.title: Label containers of hazardous substances (Worker & Community Right to Know)
rfp_requirements.description: All goods offered for purchase to the State must be labeled by the Contractor in compliance with N.J.S.A. 34:5A-1 et seq. requiring labeling of containers of hazardous substances.

rfp_requirements.title: No shift of services performance outside U.S.
rfp_requirements.description: A shift to performance of services outside the United States during the contract term shall be deemed a breach of contract and subject the contract to termination for cause, unless previously approved by the Director and the Treasurer.

rfp_requirements.title: Describe incident response plan testing
rfp_requirements.description: Describe how the incident response plan is tested and how often tests are conducted.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Inspector Training/Retraining and Testing/Retesting
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide inspector training/retraining and testing/retesting.

rfp_requirements.title: Train inspectors; ensure MVC licensing and testing
rfp_requirements.description: Inspectors must be trained by the Contractor, licensed and tested by MVC pursuant to statute N.J.S.A. 39:8-52 and other applicable regulations, including fingerprinting and criminal history checks pursuant to N.J.S.A. 39:2A-32.

rfp_requirements.title: Trainee must pass written test with 80% minimum
rfp_requirements.description: A trainee must pass a written test, which requires a minimum of 80% correct responses, covering all aspects of the training.

rfp_requirements.title: Trainee must successfully complete hands-on evaluation
rfp_requirements.description: The trainee must successfully complete a hands-on evaluation, demonstrating without assistance the ability to conduct a proper inspection and properly utilize correct equipment.

rfp_requirements.title: Demonstrate training methodology per 40 CFR 51.367
rfp_requirements.description: Pursuant to USEPA regulations at 40 CFR 51.367, the Contractor must demonstrate its proven methodology to successfully impart knowledge of the listed topics (air pollution problems, program purpose, regulations, test procedures, emission control devices, equipment operation/calibration, QC procedure

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: purpose, function, goal of inspection program
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of the purpose, function, and goal of the inspection program.

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: inspection regulations and procedures
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of inspection regulations and procedures.

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: technical details and rationale of test procedures
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of technical details of the test procedures and the rationale for their design.

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: test equipment operation, calibration, maintenance
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of test equipment operation, calibration, and maintenance.

rfp_requirements.title: Training topic: safety and health issues related to inspection process
rfp_requirements.description: Training must impart knowledge of safety and health issues related to the inspection process.

rfp_requirements.title: Include NJ-specific training and customer service
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor's inspector training program must also include New Jersey specific inspection system training, including gasoline and diesel emission inspection regulations and procedures, customer service training, and any supplemental requirements identified by MVC and/or DEP.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain inspection employees as Contractor employees
Manage day-to-day CIF operations and conduct inspections
Oversee and maintain inspection queue
Provide sufficient trained licensed staff
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor shall identify and provide a sufficient number of trained and licensed supervisors, managers, and lane inspectors to conduct inspections, perform management functions, and meet Wait Time standards.

rfp_requirements.title: Include inspection lane staff configurations
rfp_requirements.description: The Plan shall include a description of the inspection lane staff configuration(s) at each facility.

rfp_requirements.title: Include duties and responsibilities per position
rfp_requirements.description: The Plan shall include an outline of the duties and responsibilities anticipated for each position in the inspection lane.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not employ work-release/correctional persons in inspection lane
rfp_requirements.description: Persons currently participating in, or on a work-release program from any correctional institution shall not be employed in any inspection lane position by the Contractor or its subcontractor(s).

rfp_requirements.title: Operate facilities efficiently to minimize wait times
SLA: Hourly average Wait Time not to exceed 30 minutes in two contiguous hours
SLA: Monthly average Wait Time not to exceed 15 minutes
Appendix 3.2B - Facilities with physical Wait Time gates
Contractor liable for vehicle, property, and personal damage
Inspection facilities open at least 55 hours/week
Inspect all vehicles present up to closing time
Plans must maximize lane availability and up-time
Permission to install additional inspection equipment
Existing equipment remains State property
Replaced/removed inspection property released to Contractor
Sustain/improve customer interactions during inspections
Maintain Paved Areas with Weekly Sweeping
rfp_requirements.description: Maintain all paved areas and perform a weekly sweeping of all paved areas of the entire site.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain queuing, driveways, grounds, drains, signage
Maintain Drinking Water Reports Onsite
rfp_requirements.description: Maintain any drinking water quality reports from the water purveyor onsite; if site supplies own water, arrange required testing and maintenance per State and Federal regulations.

rfp_requirements.title: Monthly Emergency Exit/Lights Inspection
rfp_requirements.description: Emergency exit signs and evacuation lights must be inspected monthly.

rfp_requirements.title: Cooperate fully with audits and ensure employees/subcontractors do so
Performance audits conducted at least twice per year per lane per 40 CFR § 51.363(a)(3)(iv)
Replace all CIF and SIF light and heavy-duty brake testers
Indicator Light Check for gasoline and diesel vehicles
Perform visual inspection of fuel cap and filler area
Conduct visual fuel leak test per multiple N.J.A.C. citations
Fail vehicle for obvious emission-related defects in miscellaneous check
Diesel smoke opacity testing equipment must be State-approved
Maintain and repair all diesel smoke opacity meters
Provision, test, install, configure and migrate data for each environment
Include planned use of development and testing tools
Include plan for reviewing and testing hardware capacity
Keep Design Specification current during entire Contract term
Hardware infrastructure sufficient for 10 additional years of inspection data
Reporting tools must have flexible parameters
Provide VIR Reprint web page conforming to NJ naming standards
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must replace the legacy VIR Reprint web page (http://pweb.nj-cleanair.com/VIRPrint/pages/vir/virSearch.jsf) with a new web page that conforms to current naming standards and uses the nj.gov domain, as depicted in Figure 3.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with N.J.S.A. 39:3B-21 for School Bus Inspections
rfp_requirements.description: The State is responsible for performing all inspections on School Buses registered in New Jersey pursuant to N.J.S.A. 39:3B-21. The State reserves the right, in close coordination with the Contractor and within 72 hours' notice, to conduct school bus inspections at CIF locations pursuant to N.J.S.A.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide School Bus Inspection Search Webpage
rfp_requirements.description: Provide a webpage allowing the public to search and print out school bus inspection results using Company Name, Street Name, County, Zip Code, and Keywords.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Detailed Inspection Results Link and List Failure Items
rfp_requirements.description: Each listing must have a link for detailed viewing of the previous inspection results; for vehicles with failing inspection results, the site must also list failure items by category.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Public Facing PIF/ERF Dynamic Web Map
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide a public facing dynamic web map displaying PIF and ERF locations with differentiation between repair-only facilities and those also providing inspection services.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide ERT Certification, Information, Training, and Testing Webpage
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide a public facing web page for certification/recertification information, FAQs, rules and regulations, training modules, and testing to support the ERT program.

rfp_requirements.title: Develop ERT Training Modules Approved by SCM
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must develop training modules in consultation with DEP and approved by the SCM covering federal clean air standards, NJ air quality, ERT/ERF regulations, emissions testing, OBD repair, tampering, aftermarket catalytic convertors, emissions warranties, and technician resources.

rfp_requirements.title: Authenticate Testing Section with User ID and Password
rfp_requirements.description: The testing section of the web page must be authenticated using a user ID and password.

rfp_requirements.title: Include ASE Test Preparation Web Page
rfp_requirements.description: An ASE test preparation web page must be included providing resources for prospective technicians to assist in the ASE examination process and material covered in required testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Develop Motorist VIR Reprint Webpage
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must develop a webpage to support online viewing or printing of VIRs by the public.

rfp_requirements.title: Consolidate tests into test scripts
rfp_requirements.description: Following development of the comprehensive test matrix, each test must be consolidated into test scripts.

rfp_requirements.title: Document intent and desired outcome of each test script
rfp_requirements.description: Intent and desired outcome for each test script shall be documented by the Contractor and included with each test script.

rfp_requirements.title: Document and report all issues and testing progress
rfp_requirements.description: All issues encountered and progress in testing shall be documented and reported to the SCM by the Contractor.

rfp_requirements.title: Assist State during its acceptance testing
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall assist the State during the State's testing and in correcting problems and issues identified during State's acceptance testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify all public portals review results
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify successful review results of all public portals.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify State portals and functionality
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify successful review results of State portals and functionality.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify robust system, data, and application security
rfp_requirements.description: Acceptance testing must verify robust system, data, and application security.

rfp_requirements.title: Prepare, load, test, correct, and retest until successful
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must prepare and load test data, perform stress testing, correct problems, and re-test as necessary until test results produce consistently successful outcomes.

rfp_requirements.title: Use State-provided stress test parameters
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor stress testing parameters shall simulate peak periods and will be provided by the State to the Contractor prior to testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform stress/load testing simulating production
rfp_requirements.description: Perform successful stress/load testing in the test environment and through the test network to simulate production during testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Replace/reload data for repetitive testing
rfp_requirements.description: Replace or reload data to run repetitive test until successful results are consistently achieved.

rfp_requirements.title: Design and conduct a successful stress test
rfp_requirements.description: Design and conduct a successful stress test.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform unit testing
rfp_requirements.description: Unit testing to successfully test and debug individual code modules.

rfp_requirements.title: State acceptance testing purpose and environment
rfp_requirements.description: State acceptance testing is to assess system readiness for implementation using State's own methodologies in an environment similar to production in configuration, functionality, and performance, verifying compliance with all requirements, plans, and specifications.

rfp_requirements.title: System must pass beta testing
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor's system must pass beta testing, as evidenced by written SCM approval.

rfp_requirements.title: Use ITS to track problems, fixes and regression testing
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall use an ITS, provided by the Contractor and approved by the SCM, to track problems, fixes, and regression testing results until resolved.

rfp_requirements.title: Assist State during State's acceptance testing
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall provide assistance to the State during the State's acceptance testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide multiple sets of valid data for test scripts
rfp_requirements.description: Several sets of valid data may be made available as necessary for each script in the event a specific script cannot be completed successfully on the first attempt; several sets for both Contractor's and State's acceptance testing may be made available.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain all CIF equipment
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must check operations and provide preventive maintenance, repair or replacement of all equipment at the CIFs.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain all SIF equipment including inspection equipment
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must check operations and provide preventive maintenance, repair or replacement of all equipment at the SIFs including inspection equipment.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain equipment used by State inspection teams
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must maintain, repair or replace all equipment used by State inspection teams (bus, mobile, diesel roadside) including diesel opacity smoke meters.

rfp_requirements.title: Supply routine consumables
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must supply all routine Consumables such as printer toner or ink.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure PIF/PFF Support Hotline availability statewide
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor's PIF/PFF Support Hotline must be available to inspection facilities throughout the State during principal operating hours.

rfp_requirements.title: Dispatch repair technician within one Business Day 95% of the time
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor shall dispatch a repair technician to site to determine the problem and recommend/perform a service repair solution 95% of the time within one Business Day of receipt of the call.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide training materials to SCM one month in advance
rfp_requirements.description: Training materials must be provided for SCM review and written approval no less than one month in advance of scheduled training.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure CCRs are knowledgeable in NJ I/M program
PIF and PFF Support Hotline Availability and Response Standards
rfp_requirements.description: The PIF and PFF Support Hotline must be available to inspection facilities during principal operating hours, and 98% of calls must be received and placed in a call queue, answered within 10 minutes from the queue, or receive a return call within 2 PFF/PIF Hotline Business Hours.

rfp_requirements.title: Update and refine QA Plan to meet EPA requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Update and refine the QA Plan as required by the SCM to meet EPA requirements in 40 CFR § 51.359 and 51.363.

rfp_requirements.title: QA Plan: Inspection tests meet/exceed current standards
rfp_requirements.description: Design process in QA Plan to ensure all inspection tests meet or exceed current standards (e.g., throughput and wait times).

rfp_requirements.title: ITS must log issues from non-Help Desk staff
rfp_requirements.description: The ITS must be capable of logging and tracking any reported issues entered by other staff outside the Help Desk during system testing or daily operation.

rfp_requirements.title: Require Diesel PIFs/PFFs to purchase NG Equipment
rfp_requirements.description: All Diesel PIFs/PFFs currently using opacity meters for diesel vehicle inspections with no automated data collection shall be required to purchase the necessary NG Equipment from the Contractor.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Private Inspection Facility Support
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must provide support to Private Inspection Facilities.

rfp_requirements.title: Charge inspection transaction fee to PIFs/PFFs
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor shall charge an inspection transaction fee to the PIFs/PFFs for each inspection transaction.

rfp_requirements.title: Use MVC licensing data to determine station/inspector authorization
rfp_requirements.description: Utilize licensing information data (additions, modifications, deletions) from Inspection Services Enhanced I/M Unit of MVC to determine station and inspector authorization to perform inspections.

rfp_requirements.title: Hotline must allow inspection facilities to submit service requests
rfp_requirements.description: The PIF/PFF Support Hotline must allow inspection facilities to submit service requests as needed and must be capable of reporting and monitoring performance problems.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Centralized Inspection Facility Operations and Management
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must perform operations and management of Centralized Inspection Facilities (CIFs).

rfp_requirements.title: Plan must identify all inspection program requirements and methods
rfp_requirements.description: Plan must accurately identify all current and Contractor-initiated inspection program requirements and functions and detail Contractor's methods, processes, and procedures.

rfp_requirements.title: Operate Specialty Inspection Facilities (SIFs)
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor must operate Specialty Inspection Facilities (SIFs).

rfp_requirements.title: Provide SIFs with lane equipment identical to CIFs
rfp_requirements.description: Provide SIF sites with all necessary lane equipment identical to CIF equipment.

rfp_requirements.title: Include retrofitting and disposition of legacy equipment
rfp_requirements.description: Plan must include retrofitting CIFs and SIFs and disposition of legacy workstations and other test equipment no longer in use.

rfp_requirements.title: Remove CIF inspection equipment no longer needed
rfp_requirements.description: Upon receipt of SCM written approval, remove equipment in CIF inspection areas no longer needed under the new program (including calibration gas plumbing/tank storage cages and legacy emissions equipment).

rfp_requirements.title: Replace inspection equipment upon SCM approval
rfp_requirements.description: Upon SCM written approval, Contractor shall replace inspection equipment as needed or required.

rfp_requirements.title: Alternate UVIS solution must be specified in draft Transition Plan with Quote
rfp_requirements.description: Any alternate UVIS solution proposed by the Contractor must be fully specified in the draft Transition, Retrofit, Operations, and Management plan submitted with the Quote, approved by the SCM, and included as part of the inspection record.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide live public video feed of queuing areas
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must provide a live feed, real-time internet site for public access to view all inspection station queuing area camera images.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure sticker area accessible without queue entry
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must ensure the sticker issuance area is accessible to the motorist without requiring entry to the vehicle inspection queue.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure safe MDDV Smoke Opacity Testing environment
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor shall ensure all MDDV Smoke Opacity Testing is performed in a safe manner and that the overall environment of the CIFs remains safe for customers and personnel at all times.

rfp_requirements.title: Initially activate new equipment in only one lane at Bakers Basin
rfp_requirements.description: The Contractor must initially activate its new inspection equipment in only one (1) lane at Bakers Basin and ensure customer vehicles are tested in this designated lane.

rfp_requirements.title: Complete retrofit per approved plans
rfp_requirements.description: The retrofit, including related construction, of the inspection lane must be completed in accordance with plans, drawings, and specifications developed by the Contractor and approved by the SCM.

rfp_requirements.title: Install equipment conforming to current ATP
rfp_requirements.description: Inspection, IT, and other equipment and items required by the Contractor will be properly installed in the inspection lane and conform to then current ATP.

rfp_requirements.title: Monitor facility and lane processes for regular vehicle flow
rfp_requirements.description: The facility and lane processes must be monitored to ensure that each lane and the entire facility can accommodate a regular flow of customer vehicles and demonstrate to the State's satisfaction the inspection lane and equipment meet the specified requirements.

rfp_requirements.title: Complete retrofit of each lane and facility equipment per SCM-approved plans (full-facility beta)
rfp_requirements.description: During full-facility beta testing, the retrofit, including any related construction, of each inspection lane and other facility equipment must be completed in accordance with the plans, drawings, and specifications approved by the SCM.

rfp_requirements.title: Operational Wait Time system for entire facility
rfp_requirements.description: The Wait Time system must be operational for the entire facility during beta testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Inspection/IT equipment properly installed and conform to ATP (full-facility beta)
rfp_requirements.description: During full-facility beta testing, inspection, IT, and other equipment and items required under any Contract resulting from this Solicitation must be properly installed in the inspection lane and conform to the then current ATP.

rfp_requirements.title: Each inspection lane must meet performance standards
rfp_requirements.description: Each inspection lane, when operating as part of the whole system, must be capable of operating in conformity with the performance standards and criteria set forth in any resulting contract.

rfp_requirements.title: Facility beta test runs until State accepts results
rfp_requirements.description: The facility beta test shall run until the State accepts the corresponding results before new equipment is rolled out to all CIFs.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain Legacy EMVIM Program During Transition Period
rfp_requirements.description: During the transition period, the Contractor must maintain the Legacy New Jersey Enhanced Motor Vehicle Inspection Maintenance program described in 1.2.2.1.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct independent testing of suppliers
rfp_requirements.description: Conduct independent testing and security assessments of supplier technologies and supplier organizations.

rfp_requirements.title: Cash discount calculation rules
rfp_requirements.description: If contractor offers cash discounts for expedited payment, discount periods start the next business day after the Using Agency has accepted goods/services, received a properly signed invoice, and when required a properly executed performance security; check date is the State's response date.

rfp_requirements.title: Acknowledge replacement of SSTC Section 4.1 Indemnification
rfp_requirements.description: Section 4.1 of the State Standard Terms and Conditions is deleted in its entirety and replaced with the modified indemnification provisions set forth in Section 7.1. Contractor must operate under the revised indemnification clause.

rfp_requirements.title: IP indemnification is exclusive remedy; warranties disclaimed
rfp_requirements.description: The IP indemnification section states the entire obligation of Contractor and the exclusive remedy of the State regarding infringement of IP Rights. Contractor disclaims all warranties, conditions and other terms of non-infringement or title with respect to any product.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Domestic Preference in Subawards
rfp_requirements.description: If subawards are to be made, to the greatest extent practicable and consistent with law, include a preference for purchase, acquisition, or use of goods, products, or materials produced in the United States (including iron, aluminum, steel, cement, and other manufactured products).

rfp_requirements.title: Exclusive remedy / disclaimer of non-infringement warranties
rfp_requirements.description: Section 8.2 states the entire obligation of Contractor and its suppliers and the exclusive remedy of the State regarding any infringement or alleged infringement of Intellectual Property Rights. The indemnity and remedy are given in lieu of, and Contractor disclaims, all warranties, conditions and o

rfp_requirements.title: Hardware standard-new-equipment warranty
rfp_requirements.description: Contractor warrants that equipment offered is standard new equipment, the manufacturer's latest model in production, with parts regularly used and in production, and that no attachment or part has been substituted contrary to manufacturer's recommendations and standard practice.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow State to import/export data without interference
rfp_requirements.description: The State must have the ability to import or export data in piecemeal or entirety at its discretion without interference, including to/from other contractors.

rfp_requirements.title: Recognize SEIU Local 518 as exclusive bargaining representative
rfp_requirements.description: Parsons Motor Vehicle Inspection and Maintenance Corp. recognizes SEIU Local 518 as the sole and exclusive collective bargaining representative of employees in the specified bargaining units and statewide classifications with respect to wages, hours, and other terms and conditions of employment.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply Agreement to new/relocated inspection locations in NJ
rfp_requirements.description: The Agreement shall apply and continue in full force and effect at vehicle inspection locations to which the Employer may move within NJ or to the provision of services at private inspection stations.

rfp_requirements.title: Apply contract to new or additional inspection stations
rfp_requirements.description: The contract shall apply to any new or additional vehicle inspection stations of the Employer under its principal direction and control within NJ.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify shop steward and delegate prior to drug/alcohol testing
rfp_requirements.description: Prior to the drug and alcohol testing of any employee, the Employer shall notify the shop steward and delegate.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain overtime records and provide on request
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer must maintain records of all overtime, rotational order, call status, and total overtime worked/refused by each employee; these must be made available upon request to Union officers, representatives, and affected employees.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer vehicle inspection overtime to full-time Lane Techs first
rfp_requirements.description: The Employer must offer Senior Lane Technicians, Lane Technicians and full-time Associate Lane Technicians overtime work related to inspection of vehicles before any other employees, including part-time ALTs; for all other bargaining units, overtime goes to full-time employees with most seniority.

rfp_requirements.title: Schedule minimum 3 employees in single-lane stations
rfp_requirements.description: In stations with only one inspection lane, the Employer must schedule at least three employees including at least one Senior Lane Technician and one Lane Technician.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay out unused sick leave upon retirement or separation
rfp_requirements.description: Upon retirement or separation, accrued but unused sick leave shall be paid to the Employee at the highest rate of pay received during the last year of employment.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide full union release time for safety inspection designees
rfp_requirements.description: Except first and last two business days of each month, Employer shall provide full union release time to up to five Union delegates/officers/representatives designated for safety inspections; a sixth may be designated for the 2nd and 3rd weeks of each month.

rfp_requirements.title: Comply with safety inspection reporting requirements
rfp_requirements.description: Employees assigned to safety inspections shall comply with reporting requirements reasonably imposed by the Employer and discuss findings at end of work day; findings shall not be the basis for discipline.

rfp_requirements.title: Reimburse safety inspection mileage and tolls up to $20,000/year
rfp_requirements.description: Employer will reimburse Employees for automobile mileage and toll expenses for safety inspections; total reimbursements shall not exceed $20,000 per contract year; unused amounts do not carry over.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay unused vacation upon separation or retirement
rfp_requirements.description: Upon separation or retirement, Employee is entitled to payment for unused vacation time prorated based on months worked, plus any vacation carried over from preceding year.

rfp_requirements.title: Pay higher classification rate for assignments over 3 consecutive days
rfp_requirements.description: Any Lane Technician or Associate Lane Technician assigned to work in a higher classification for more than 3 consecutive days shall be paid at the higher classification rate for the entire duration of the assignment.

rfp_requirements.title: Set aaChgICD to indicate oldStickerDate vs Prev IED
rfp_requirements.description: Set Temp.aaChgICD to 'E' when using Prev IED or 'Y' when using oldStickerDate.

rfp_requirements.title: aaCycleBeg used in both BeginTest and EndTest rules with different semantics
rfp_requirements.description: Temp.aaCycleBeg is used in both BeginTest and EndTest rulesets and has a different use/value in the EndTest rules than in the BeginTest rules.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Data - aaCycleBeg dual use

rfp_requirements.title: Set aaCycleEnd to today +2 months EOM
rfp_requirements.description: Temp.aaCycleEnd must be set to today + 2 months, last day of the month.

rfp_requirements.title: Set aaCycleFutEnd to today + cycle length + 2 months EOM
rfp_requirements.description: Temp.aaCycleFutEnd must be set to today + cycle length + 2 months, last day of the month.

rfp_requirements.title: Set aaCycleInvalid to today + 61 months EOM
rfp_requirements.description: Temp.aaCycleInvalid must be set to today + 61 months, last day of the month, as the last date for a valid dealer sticker.

rfp_requirements.title: Restrict aaOffset range to -11 to +11
rfp_requirements.description: The aaOffset value, representing the difference between the current month and sticker date month, must be within -11 to +11.

rfp_requirements.title: aaOffset used in both BeginTest and EndTest rulesets with different semantics
rfp_requirements.description: Temp.aaOffset is set and used in both the BeginTest and the EndTest rulesets, with a different use/value in the EndTest rules.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Data - aaOffset dual use

rfp_requirements.title: Set cycleStartDate as last day of the month beginning the cycle
rfp_requirements.description: cycleStartDate marks the beginning of a vehicle's current cycle, defined as the last day of the month that begins the cycle.

rfp_requirements.title: Treat sticker dates more than 5 years future as error
rfp_requirements.description: A vehicle with a sticker date more than five years in the future is in error and follows the same recalculation rule.

rfp_requirements.title: Worked example: 10/2010 sticker presented in 2009 yields cycleStartDate 10/31/2008
rfp_requirements.description: For an off-cycle future vehicle example, a vehicle with a 10/2010 sticker presented in 2009 nominally passed in 2008, so the cycleStartDate is set to 10/31/2008.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Data - cycleStartDate Example

rfp_requirements.title: Set inspExpirationDateCycle values per vehicle type
rfp_requirements.description: Set inspExpirationDateCycle (cycle length in months) to 6 for buses, 12 for commercial vehicles and omnibus2s, and 24 for everything else.

rfp_requirements.title: Change inspProgramType to DC and force one-year sticker for heavy duty diesel trucks
rfp_requirements.description: For heavy duty diesel trucks, change the inspProgramType to DC and set vehicleCategory to 'comm' to force a one-year sticker.

rfp_requirements.title: Validate inspProgramType against facility type and pifClass
rfp_requirements.description: Check whether inspProgramType is valid at the current facility based on facility type and pifClass; invalid combinations must terminate the rules.

rfp_requirements.title: Validate vehicle configuration against inspProgramType for non-bus
rfp_requirements.description: For non-bus vehicles, check whether the vehicle configuration is valid for the inspProgramType; invalid combinations must terminate the rules.

rfp_requirements.title: Add TempHold entity to Inspection
rfp_requirements.description: Add a TempHold entity to the Inspection to hold temporary attributes during processing.

rfp_requirements.title: Terminate ruleset when required attributes are null/invalid
rfp_requirements.description: Certain attributes must have valid non-null values; if they do not, the CycleValidation_v5 rulesheet must terminate the ruleset.

rfp_requirements.title: Set dates required to calculate cycle/expiration and aaChgICD
rfp_requirements.description: Set certain dates required to calculate cycle and expiration dates, and set temp value aaChgICD to control whether old sticker date or old inspExpirationDate is used.

rfp_requirements.title: Set cycle length based on vehicleCategory and inspProgramType
rfp_requirements.description: Set the cycle length (6, 12, or 24 months) based on vehicleCategory and inspProgramType.

rfp_requirements.title: Include DC/norm combination for completeness even though it does not occur
rfp_requirements.description: The combination of inspProgramType DC with vehicleCategory 'norm' does not occur but must be included for completeness in the SetCycleLength rulesheet.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Notes - SetCycleLength DC/norm

rfp_requirements.title: SetCycleStartDate_2 handles non-bus out-of-range dates (>22 months old or >2 months future)
rfp_requirements.description: SetCycleStartDate_2 runs for non-bus vehicles when the dates are out of range — for example, more than 22 months old or more than 2 months in the future — and sets the cycleStartDate month/year based on the offset value from SetCycleStartDate_1.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Notes - SetCycleStartDate_2 range

rfp_requirements.title: SetCycleStartDate_3 handles bus out-of-range dates (>4 months old or >2 months future)
rfp_requirements.description: SetCycleStartDate_3 runs for bus vehicles when the dates are out of range — for example, more than 4 months old or more than 2 months in the future — and sets the cycleStartDate based on the offset value from SetCycleStartDate_1.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Notes - SetCycleStartDate_3 range

rfp_requirements.title: Inspection cycle type code values: 'I' initial and 'R' retest
rfp_requirements.description: SetInspCycleTypeCode must set the cycle type as 'I' (initial) or 'R' (retest) based on previous inspection data.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Notes - SetInspCycleTypeCode values

rfp_requirements.title: Inspection mode code values: 'C' cycle test and 'O' off-cycle
rfp_requirements.description: SetInspModeCode must set the inspection mode as 'C' (cycle test) or 'O' (off-cycle) based on previous inspection data.
rfp_requirements.section: Begin Test Cycle Notes - SetInspModeCode values

rfp_requirements.title: Default mvcRegCode for bus inspections based on inspProgramType
rfp_requirements.description: For bus inspections, set a default mvcRegCode if none was entered, based on inspProgramType (CB or SB).

rfp_requirements.title: Default mvcRegCode for IM inspections based on indicators
rfp_requirements.description: For IM inspections, set a default mvcRegCode if none was entered, based on the commercial, transport, and omni2 indicators.

rfp_requirements.title: Set vehicleCategory for bus inspections
rfp_requirements.description: For bus inspections, set the vehicleCategory based on inspProgramType (CB or SB).

rfp_requirements.title: Set vehicleCategory for IM; terminate on invalid combinations
rfp_requirements.description: For IM inspections, set the vehicleCategory based on mvcRegCode and the three indicators; invalid combinations must cause the rules to terminate.

rfp_requirements.title: Set vehicleCategory to 'norm' for motorcycles
rfp_requirements.description: For motorcycles, the vehicleCategory must be set to 'norm'.

rfp_requirements.title: Select primary EM tests for IM inspections based on vehicle attributes
rfp_requirements.description: When inspProgramType is 'IM', based on vehicleSize, fuelType, vehicleYear, and omni2Indicator set CurrInsp.primaryEmTestCode, primaryEmTestRequired, primaryEmResult = N when Required = F, and safetyTestType. Invalid combinations must allow re-entry or termination.

rfp_requirements.title: Initialize values for BeginTestSelection ruleset
rfp_requirements.description: Initialize all values required for the BeginTestSelection ruleset at the start of execution.

rfp_requirements.title: Add a TempHold entity
rfp_requirements.description: Add a TempHold entity at the start of the BeginTestSelection ruleset.

rfp_requirements.title: Validate required attributes and terminate on invalid values
rfp_requirements.description: Check the following for valid values and terminate on any invalid value: CurrInsp.inspProgramType, CurrVehicle.vehicleSize, CurrVehicle.fuelType, CurrVehicle.vehicleYear (not null), CurrVehicle.omni2Indicator, CurrFacility.facilityProgramCode, CurrFacility.pifClassCode, CurrWkstn.gasbenchTestAllowed

rfp_requirements.title: Change inspTypeCode and inspProgramType to 'DC' for HD Diesel
rfp_requirements.description: CheckForDC must run only if inspProgramType='IM' and for HD Diesel vehicles change inspTypeCode and inspProgramType to 'DC'.

rfp_requirements.title: Validate Program Type and Facility Combination
rfp_requirements.description: CheckPgmTypeAndFacility must compare inspProgramType, facilityType, and pifClassCode for validity; invalid combination allows re-entry or termination.

rfp_requirements.title: Validate Program Type and Vehicle Configuration for Non-Bus
rfp_requirements.description: CheckPgmTypeAndVehicle_Std must run for non-bus and compare inspProgramType, vehicleSize, fuelType, and omni2Indicator for validity; some invalid combinations cause termination, others allow re-entry or termination.

rfp_requirements.title: Terminate for Invalid Codes in CycleValidation_v5
rfp_requirements.description: CycleValidation_v5 must terminate for invalid pifClassCode, invalid inspTypeCode, invalid facilityType, invalid fuelCode, and invalid vehicleGVWR<=0.

rfp_requirements.title: Set Reference Dates and aaChgICD
rfp_requirements.description: SetCurrMonth must set reference dates (aaCurrMonth, aaCycleBeg, aaCycleEnd, aaCycleFutEnd) and set aaChgICD to 'E' or 'Y' based on PrevInsp.chgICDCode. Note: inspDate is used instead of today to ease testing.

rfp_requirements.title: Compute aaCycleFutEnd using inspDate + 2 + inspExpirationDateCycle months EOM
rfp_requirements.description: Temp.aaCycleFutEnd must be calculated as CurrInsp.inspDate.addMonths(2 + CurrInsp.inspExpirationDateCycle).eom.

rfp_requirements.title: Compute aaCycleInvalid using inspDate + 61 months EOM
rfp_requirements.description: Temp.aaCycleInvalid must be calculated as CurrInsp.inspDate.addMonths(61).endOfMonth.

rfp_requirements.title: Set inspExpirationDateCycle Length
rfp_requirements.description: SetCycleLength must set inspExpirationDateCycle length based on vehicleCategory and inspProgramType.

rfp_requirements.title: Evaluate Prev IED and oldStickerDate against five date ranges
rfp_requirements.description: Compare the Prev IED and oldStickerDate against the five defined date ranges (invalid past, current cycle, next cycle, dealer cycle, invalid future) using aaCycleBeg, aaCycleEnd, aaCycleFutEnd, and aaCycleInvalid.

rfp_requirements.title: Set cycleStartDate from one of three computed dates
rfp_requirements.description: The cycleStartDate must be set to one of aaDateCurr, aaDatePrev, or aaDateNext based on aaOffset.

rfp_requirements.title: Set fuelType Based on fuelCode
rfp_requirements.description: SetFuelType rule sheet must set fuelType based on fuelCode.

rfp_requirements.title: Set inspExtentCode based on inspCycleTypeCode
rfp_requirements.description: Set inspExtentCode from the value of inspCycleTypeCode.

rfp_requirements.title: Run only when inspCycleTypeCode is retest
rfp_requirements.description: SetInspExtentCodeBusExpire must run only if inspCycleTypeCode is 'retest'.

rfp_requirements.title: Run only for bus inspProgramType
rfp_requirements.description: SetInspExtentCodeBusExpire must run only when the inspProgramType is for a bus.

rfp_requirements.title: Set Default mvcRegCode for Bus
rfp_requirements.description: SetNullMvcRegCode_Bus must run only for bus with mvcRegCode=0 and set default mvcRegCode based on inspProgramType.

rfp_requirements.title: Set Default mvcRegCode for Non-Bus (IM)
rfp_requirements.description: SetNullMvcRegCode_IM must run only for non-bus with mvcRegCode=0 and set default mvcRegCode based on commercialIndicator, transportIndicator, and omni2Indicator.

rfp_requirements.title: Set inspProgramType Based on inspTypeCode
rfp_requirements.description: SetProgramType rule sheet must set CurrInsp.inspProgramType based on CurrInsp.inspTypeCode.

rfp_requirements.title: Set Bus Vehicle Category
rfp_requirements.description: SetVehicleCategory_Bus_v5 must run only for bus inspProgramType, compare mvcRegCode and inspProgramType for validity, and set CurrVehicle.vehicleCategory to 'cbus' or 'sbus'; invalid combinations allow re-entry or termination.

rfp_requirements.title: Set IM Vehicle Category
rfp_requirements.description: SetVehicleCategory_IM_v5c must run only for IM inspProgramType, compare mvcRegCode, omni2Indicator, transportIndicator, and commercialIndicator for validity, and set CurrVehicle.vehicleCategory to 'comm', 'norm', 'trans', or 'omni'; invalid combinations allow re-entry or termination.

rfp_requirements.title: Set Motorcycle Vehicle Category
rfp_requirements.description: SetVehicleCategory_MC_v5 must run only for motorcycle inspProgramType and set CurrVehicle.vehicleCategory to 'norm'.

rfp_requirements.title: Set vehicleSize Based on vehicleGVWR
rfp_requirements.description: SetVehicleSize rule sheet must set vehicleSize based on vehicleGVWR.

rfp_requirements.title: Conduct Remote Observation Audits
rfp_requirements.description: Remote Observation Audits are unannounced audits performed by stationing auditor(s) at a discreet distance from a Central Lane to observe the inspection process.

rfp_requirements.title: Define aaCycleBeg
rfp_requirements.description: aaCycleBeg marks the earliest date a vehicle can be inspected relative to its cycleStartDate; previous inspections earlier than this date are ignored; it is cycleStartDate - 2 months, first day of the month.

rfp_requirements.title: Do not lift vehicles without appropriate lifting points
rfp_requirements.description: Vehicles with a full plastic covering that completely obscures the front suspension undercarriage, or with other obstructing objects (e.g., steering dampeners), must not be lifted.

rfp_requirements.title: Notify station manager for no-lift decision on vehicles over 50,000 miles
rfp_requirements.description: Whenever an inspector decides not to lift a vehicle which has over 50,000 miles, the inspector must immediately notify the station manager.

rfp_requirements.title: Turn off air suspension before lifting
rfp_requirements.description: If a vehicle is suspected to have air suspension (identified by absence of coil springs and presence of bellow-type bags and air hoses), the air suspension should be turned off before lifting.
rfp_requirements.section: Do Not Lift Vehicles - Air Suspension

rfp_requirements.title: Display Facility Contact Information (South Brunswick Example)
rfp_requirements.description: The inspection report template must display facility contact info including address (2236 Route 130, Dayton, NJ 08810), phone (888-656-6867), Facility ID (CIF000123 example), and Workstation ID (CL009200 example).

rfp_requirements.title: Support Two Inspection Cycles (Current Date and Sticker Date)
rfp_requirements.description: Two cycles must affect the inspection process: one relative to the current date/month allowing on-cycle inspection up to two months prior to sticker expiration, and one relative to the vehicle's sticker date for 6/12/24 month activity with the two-month early window.

rfp_requirements.title: Allow On-Cycle Inspection Up to Two Months Prior to Sticker Expiration
rfp_requirements.description: A vehicle must be allowed to be inspected 'on-cycle' up to two months prior to its sticker expiration date (e.g., in March vehicles with a May sticker can be inspected on-cycle, but a June vehicle would be off-cycle).

rfp_requirements.title: Set testExtentCode to 'T' on Warning or Violation
rfp_requirements.description: When a Warning or Violation is set, the testExtentCode must also be set to 'T'.

rfp_requirements.title: Keep lift free of corrosive agents and solvents
rfp_requirements.description: Failure to keep lift free of corrosive agents and solvents will lead to reduced service life that could cause property damage or personal injury.

rfp_requirements.title: Perform Test in Conformance with Federal Clean Air Act Section 207(b)
rfp_requirements.description: The emissions inspection test must be performed in conformance with section 207(b) of the Federal Clean Air Act.

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure vehicle centered so plate contacts each control arm
rfp_requirements.description: The inspector must ensure that the vehicle is centered on the lift plate so the plate contacts each side of the vehicle's control arms respectively.

rfp_requirements.title: Verify vehicle centered on lift to contact both frame rails
rfp_requirements.description: The inspector must verify that the vehicle is centered on the lift sufficiently that the lift plate will contact the right and left side frame rails.

rfp_requirements.title: License plate centering procedure may not apply to solid axle vehicles
rfp_requirements.description: On solid axle/4WD vehicle types, the license plate centering procedure might not be the best lineup; inspectors must look for good lifting points on both sides rather than relying on the standard centering method.

rfp_requirements.title: Push lift handle down forcefully and fully when lowering
rfp_requirements.description: To lower the lift, the handle must be pushed down forcefully and fully to allow maximum air to escape out of the lift assembly, ensuring a quicker descent rate.

rfp_requirements.title: Weekly inspection of jack and components
rfp_requirements.description: Inspect the jack and its components weekly for damage or excessive wear, and replace parts as required.

rfp_requirements.title: Manager to email Manager of Training for no-lift list additions
rfp_requirements.description: When a manager determines a vehicle cannot be lifted or requires special handling, the manager must email the Manager of Training requesting the vehicle be added to the list.

rfp_requirements.title: Cycle jack before lifting vehicle
rfp_requirements.description: Before lifting a vehicle, operate the jack through a couple of cycles to become familiar with the controls.

rfp_requirements.title: Cease testing immediately upon QC/QA audit failure
rfp_requirements.description: The contractor shall immediately cease vehicle testing at any lane or station where equipment or system fails a quality control or quality assurance audit.

rfp_requirements.title: Reset previous inspection attributes to null
rfp_requirements.description: The system shall execute the three reset steps (ResetPrevICD_Null, ResetPrevEmCD_Null, ResetPrevSafetyCD_Null) to reset previous inspection attributes back to null.

rfp_requirements.title: Install spacer at base of post for non-Challenger lifts if jack touches ground
rfp_requirements.description: After the jack is installed on the hoist rails, lower the hoist to its lowest position. If the jack touches the ground, a spacer is required at the base of each post to keep the runway from lowering. Spacers can be ordered in different sizes (common sizes used are 1 inch tall and ½ inch tall).

rfp_requirements.title: Engine OFF, transmission in NEUTRAL, parking brake OFF before lifting
rfp_requirements.description: Ensure the engine is OFF, the transmission is in NEUTRAL, and the parking brake is OFF before lifting the vehicle.

rfp_requirements.title: Raise lift to release safety locks when lift will not lower
rfp_requirements.description: If the air extinguishes but the lift plate does not lower, the inspector must raise the lift back up slightly to allow the safety locks to release automatically.

rfp_requirements.title: Retry lifting higher than first attempt if lift will not lower
rfp_requirements.description: If the lift still does not lower after the first release attempt, retry lifting the vehicle higher than the first attempt and then lowering.

rfp_requirements.title: State Treasurer to choose one of three program responsibility options
rfp_requirements.description: The State Treasurer must select one of three specified options (full State responsibility, contract with private contractor, or partial State responsibility with contractor) for the design, construction, renovation, equipment, establishment, maintenance, and operation of official inspection faciliti

rfp_requirements.title: Contractor prohibition on motor vehicle sales, maintenance, repair, or parts business
rfp_requirements.description: A contractor operating an official inspection facility, and any of its officers or employees, must not be engaged in the business of selling, maintaining, or repairing motor vehicles or selling motor vehicle replacement or repair parts.

rfp_requirements.title: Site new or relocated inspection facilities near population centers
rfp_requirements.description: New or relocated inspection facilities must be sited close to population centers, but in locations that remain convenient for suburban and rural residents.

rfp_requirements.title: Operate inspection facility at least 55 hours per week with extended and weekend hours
rfp_requirements.description: An inspection facility must be open for inspections, exclusive of holidays, at least 55 hours each week, including hours before 9:00 a.m. or after 5:00 p.m. on weekdays and hours on the weekend, subject to survey-based adjustments.

rfp_requirements.title: Maintain climate-controlled waiting area
rfp_requirements.description: An inspection facility must maintain a climate-controlled waiting area for persons whose motor vehicles are being inspected.

rfp_requirements.title: Reserve at least one lane for reinspections
rfp_requirements.description: At least one lane at each inspection facility must be reserved to the extent practicable for reinspections, though the lane may be opened to initial inspections when no reinspections are being performed.

rfp_requirements.title: Justify increases in inspection lanes by cost-effectiveness
rfp_requirements.description: The number of inspection lanes in the contract to be constructed may be increased to meet the Chief Administrator's standards only if the contractor can show the increase is more cost-effective than extending operating hours.

rfp_requirements.title: Establish toll-free number and computerized sign network for wait times
rfp_requirements.description: A toll-free telephone number and a network of computerized signs must be established, and public service announcements must be aired to advise motorists of the length of lines at inspection facilities.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide required written EPA-disclosure document to each motorist
rfp_requirements.description: Each motor vehicle operator who arrives at a facility for an inspection must be provided with a written document containing the exact statement regarding the federal imposition of the emission test.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer employment proportional to inspection lanes operated when multiple contracts awarded
rfp_requirements.description: If more than one contract for operation of official inspection facilities is awarded, each contractor must offer full-time employment to a percentage of terminated employees equal to the percentage of total inspection lanes that will be operated by that contractor.

rfp_requirements.title: Provide consumer-friendly motor vehicle inspection services
rfp_requirements.description: A contract for operation of an official inspection facility must provide for motor vehicle inspection services that are consumer-friendly to the maximum extent feasible.

rfp_requirements.title: Chief Administrator to adopt regulations governing contractor inspections
rfp_requirements.description: The chief administrator must adopt regulations pursuant to the Administrative Procedure Act to establish the conduct of inspections by any person who has entered into a contract with the State.

rfp_requirements.title: Data at inspection facilities is State property accessible to MVC
rfp_requirements.description: Data generated at any official inspection facility is the property of the State and must be fully accessible to the New Jersey Motor Vehicle Commission at any time.

rfp_requirements.title: Offer employment first to existing qualified CBA-covered employees on contract renewal/new award
rfp_requirements.description: For any contract renewal or award of a new contract involving operation of an official inspection facility in New Jersey, existing qualified employees covered by a collective bargaining agreement must be the first to be offered employment to meet the staffing requirements (as determined by the emplo

rfp_requirements.title: Review Bid Solicitation and submit questions before deadline
rfp_requirements.description: Bidders must review the Bid Solicitation in its entirety and submit any questions, including exceptions to the SSTC, prior to the deadline.

rfp_requirements.title: Commission may alter solicitation terms via addenda without reissuance
rfp_requirements.description: For any solicitation issued on or before the effective date of this act, or within six months thereafter, involving operation of an official inspection facility, if the commission or its designee determines alteration of terms/conditions/requirements is necessary to conform to this act, such alterat

rfp_requirements.title: Ensure low-hanging exhaust is not lifted first
rfp_requirements.description: The inspector must ensure that the exhaust is not hanging too low and that the lift plate will not contact and lift the car first from the low hanging exhaust system.

rfp_requirements.title: Use enclosed rubber lifting blocks when clearance is needed
rfp_requirements.description: In cases where low-hanging components (such as exhaust) interfere, the inspector must slide the enclosed rubber lifting blocks between the lift plate and the appropriate lifting point to allow adequate clearance.

rfp_requirements.title: Present Official Inspection Record for Reinspection
rfp_requirements.description: The vehicle inspection report must be presented if the vehicle is to be reinspected, as it constitutes an official record.

rfp_requirements.title: Correct Advisory Conditions Within 60 Days
rfp_requirements.description: The vehicle owner must correct advisory condition(s) within 60 days from the date of inspection, or the vehicle may be cited for failure to make repairs pursuant to NJSA 39:8-9.

rfp_requirements.title: Mark Advisory Conditions with Code 'A' in VID (INSP_CONDITIONS Table)
rfp_requirements.description: Advisory conditions shown on the inspection report must correspond to codes having 'A' in the VID INSP_CONDITIONS table.

rfp_requirements.title: Label Duplicate Vehicle Inspection Reports
rfp_requirements.description: When the inspection report is reprinted as a duplicate, it must be clearly labeled 'Vehicle Inspection Report <(Duplicate)>'.

rfp_requirements.title: Display Primary and Secondary Emissions Test Results
rfp_requirements.description: The inspection report must display the Primary Emission Test Performed (e.g., OBD, Snap Opacity, IDLE) and Secondary Emissions Test(s) Performed including Gas Cap, Tampering, Visible Smoke, Liquid Leak, Indicator Light, and Misc. Emissions results.

rfp_requirements.title: Display Gas Cap Result as N/A for OBD Primary Test
rfp_requirements.description: When the primary emission test is OBD, Snap Opacity, or IDLE, the Gas Cap secondary test result must display as 'N/A' on the report.
rfp_requirements.section: Vehicle Inspection Report - Gas Cap N/A

rfp_requirements.title: Display Idle Mode Gas Readings (HC, CO%, CO2%, O2)
rfp_requirements.description: For vehicles tested in IDLE mode, the report must display gas readings and standard results for HC, CO%, CO2%, and O2.

rfp_requirements.title: Display Inspector Name and ID on Report
rfp_requirements.description: The inspection report must show the Inspector's name and Inspector ID (e.g., ERIC K. GOEBEL INL000703).

rfp_requirements.title: Provide Explanation Section for Misc. Emissions Findings
rfp_requirements.description: The report must include an EXPLANATION section for Misc. Emissions items marked 'See Explanation'.
rfp_requirements.section: Vehicle Inspection Report - Misc Emissions Explanation

rfp_requirements.title: Display Snap Opacity Reading, Standard, and Result
rfp_requirements.description: For vehicles with Primary Emission Test of Snap Opacity, the report must display the FINAL opacity reading (average value), Standard, and Result.

rfp_requirements.title: Display PASS-Advisory Final Result When Advisory Conditions Present
rfp_requirements.description: When advisory safety conditions are identified, the inspection report must display 'FINAL RESULT: PASS-Advisory' along with the overall safety, emissions, and credentials results.

rfp_requirements.title: Display Final Result and Overall Safety/Emissions/Credentials Results
rfp_requirements.description: The inspection report must display the FINAL RESULT along with Overall Safety Results, Overall Emissions Result, and Credentials results.

rfp_requirements.title: Example Data Placeholders (VIN ABPL265FW11429301, Plate GFFD592)
rfp_requirements.description: Sample barcode values use VIN 'ABPL265FW11429301', Registration Plate 'GFFD592βββ', and Inspection Expiration Date '20161130' — contractors must support these example formats including β character padding.
rfp_requirements.section: Vehicle Inspection Report - Sample VIN and Plate
